attribution.text: Macros: Classic WoW Forever, licenciadas sob CC BY 4.0.

macros.title: Mouseover Dispel Magic
macros.desc: Dispel a friendly or hostile mouseover, or your selected target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Dispel Magic
/cast [@mouseover,exists,nodead][] Dispel Magic
macros.needs: Dispel Magic learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Dissipar Magia
/cast [@mouseover,exists,nodead][] Dissipar Magia

macros.title: Mouseover Fortitude
macros.desc: Buff a friendly unit under your cursor without retargeting.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Power Word: Fortitude
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Power Word: Fortitude
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Palavra de Poder: Fortitude
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Palavra de Poder: Fortitude

macros.title: Mouseover Fear Ward
macros.desc: Ward the friend under your cursor against Fear, or your target, or yourself if neither is a friend.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Fear Ward
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Fear Ward
macros.needs: Fear Ward learned (level 20). Every Priest gets it in Forever, with a 3 min cooldown and a 3 min ward. In Classic it was a racial spell.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Proteção contra Medo
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Proteção contra Medo

macros.title: Mouseover Shackle Undead
macros.desc: Shackle an undead enemy under your cursor, or your target, without switching what you're attacking.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Shackle Undead
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Shackle Undead
macros.needs: Shackle Undead learned (level 20). Only one target can be shackled at a time.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Agrilhoar Morto-vivo
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Agrilhoar Morto-vivo

macros.title: Wand that stays on
macros.desc: Start wanding. Pressing it again keeps the wand firing instead of switching it off.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Shoot
/cast !Shoot
macros.needs: A wand equipped in the ranged slot
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Atirar
/cast !Atirar

macros.title: Mouseover Resurrection
macros.desc: Resurrect the dead player under your cursor, or your dead target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Resurrection
/cast [@mouseover,help,dead][help,dead] Resurrection
macros.needs: Resurrection learned. It can't be cast in combat.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Ressurreição
/cast [@mouseover,help,dead][help,dead] Ressurreição

macros.title: Dismount and Levitate
macros.desc: Get off your mount and Levitate yourself. Hold Shift to cancel Levitate.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Levitate
/dismount
/cancelaura [mod:shift] Levitate
/cast [nomod] Levitate

keys.text: Dismount, then Levitate yourself
Cancel Levitate

macros.needs: Levitate learned (level 34). Mounting or taking damage ends it.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Levitar
/dismount
/cancelaura [mod:shift] Levitar
/cast [nomod] Levitar

macros.title: Self buffs in order
macros.desc: Buff yourself one spell per press: Inner Fire, then Power Word: Fortitude, then Divine Spirit.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/castsequence [@player] reset=15 Inner Fire, Power Word: Fortitude, Divine Spirit
macros.needs: Divine Spirit learned (level 30). It's baseline in Forever, so it joins the Classic buff sequence. Drop it from the end until then.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/castsequence [@player] reset=15 Fogo Interior, Palavra de Poder: Fortitude, Espírito Divino

macros.title: Lesser Heal on friends, Smite on enemies
macros.desc: Heal a friendly mouseover first. Otherwise, Smite a hostile target, heal a friendly target, or heal yourself with no valid target. Useful from level 1.
macros.code:
#showtooltip
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead] Lesser Heal; [harm,nodead] Smite; [help,nodead][@player] Lesser Heal
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead] Cura Inferior; [harm,nodead] Punição; [help,nodead][@player] Cura Inferior

macros.title: Mouseover Power Word: Shield
macros.desc: Shield a friendly mouseover, your target, or yourself.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Power Word: Shield
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Power Word: Shield
macros.needs: Power Word: Shield learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Palavra de Poder: Escudo
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Palavra de Poder: Escudo

macros.title: Power Word: Shield with Shift and Alt
macros.desc: Shield your mouseover, target or yourself. Shift shields your target's target, Alt shields you.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Power Word: Shield
/cast [mod:alt,@player][mod:shift,@targettarget,help,nodead][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Power Word: Shield

keys.text: Shield your mouseover, then your target, then yourself
Shield your target's target if it's a friend
Shield yourself

macros.needs: Power Word: Shield learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Palavra de Poder: Escudo
/cast [mod:alt,@player][mod:shift,@targettarget,help,nodead][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Palavra de Poder: Escudo

macros.title: Power Word: Shield, Rank 6 with Shift
macros.desc: Shield your mouseover, target or yourself. Hold Shift for Rank 6 when a lighter, cheaper shield will do.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Power Word: Shield
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Power Word: Shield(Rank 6); [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Power Word: Shield

keys.text: Top-rank shield on your mouseover, target or you
Rank 6 shield on the same aim

macros.needs: Power Word: Shield Rank 6 learned (level 36)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Palavra de Poder: Escudo
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Palavra de Poder: Escudo(Grau 6); [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Palavra de Poder: Escudo

macros.title: Penance for heals, Shift for damage
macros.desc: Heal a friendly mouseover, target or yourself; hold Shift to damage your hostile target. Repeated presses let your current Penance channel finish.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Penance
/stopmacro [channeling:Penance]
/cast [mod:shift,harm,nodead][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Penance

keys.text: Heal your mouseover, then your target, then yourself
Damage your hostile target

macros.needs: Penance talent (Discipline). Rank 1 is level 30, with a 12 sec cooldown.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Penitência
/stopmacro [channeling:Penance]
/cast [mod:shift,harm,nodead][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Penitência

macros.title: Inner Focus into Greater Heal
macros.desc: Pop Inner Focus and start a free Greater Heal on your mouseover, target or yourself.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Greater Heal
/cast Inner Focus
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Greater Heal
macros.needs: Inner Focus talent and Greater Heal learned (level 40)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Cura Maior
/cast Concentração Interior
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Cura Maior

macros.title: Power Infusion on a friend or you
macros.desc: Put Power Infusion on the friend under your cursor, then your target, then yourself. Alt always picks you.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Power Infusion
/cast [mod:alt,@player][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Power Infusion

keys.text: Infuse your mouseover, then your target, then yourself
Infuse yourself

macros.needs: Power Infusion talent (Discipline, level 40)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Infusão de Poder
/cast [mod:alt,@player][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Infusão de Poder

macros.title: Mouseover Mana Burn
macros.desc: Burn another enemy’s mana while keeping your selected target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Mana Burn
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Mana Burn
macros.needs: Mana Burn learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Exaurir Mana
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Exaurir Mana

macros.title: Mouseover Contingency Plan
macros.desc: Ward a friend under your cursor, your target or yourself. When their Health drops below 35% they get a shield and a heal over time. Its shield and heal-over-time can coexist with Power Word: Shield and Renew.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Contingency Plan
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Contingency Plan
macros.needs: Gnome Priest, level 20; one ward per target. Blizzard's 30 September guide gives a 5 min cooldown; the live client still shows 10 min.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Plano de Contingência
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Plano de Contingência

macros.title: Divine Grace on a hurt friend
macros.desc: Heal a friend below half health right away and clear their Weakened Soul so you can shield them again.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Divine Grace
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead] Divine Grace
macros.needs: Human Priest. Target below 50% Health; cannot target yourself. Blizzard's 30 September guide gives a 5 min cooldown; the live client still shows 10 min.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Graça Divina
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead] Graça Divina

macros.title: Mouseover Divine Spirit
macros.desc: Buff the friend under your cursor with Divine Spirit, or your target, or yourself.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Divine Spirit
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Divine Spirit
macros.needs: Divine Spirit learned (level 30). Every Priest gets it in Forever. In Classic it was a Discipline talent.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Espírito Divino
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Espírito Divino

macros.title: Mouseover Prayer of Fortitude
macros.desc: Cast Prayer of Fortitude on the friend under your cursor, your target or yourself.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Prayer of Fortitude
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Prayer of Fortitude
macros.needs: Prayer of Fortitude learned (level 48). Forever's tooltip covers all party and raid members, where Classic's covered the target's party.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Prece da Fortitude
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Prece da Fortitude

macros.title: Mouseover Flash Heal
macros.desc: Heal a party frame under your cursor, then your target, then yourself.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Flash Heal
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Flash Heal
macros.needs: Flash Heal learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Cura Célere
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Cura Célere

macros.title: Holy Fire or Smite
macros.desc: Hold Shift for Smite; press normally for Holy Fire.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Smite; Holy Fire
/cast [mod:shift] Smite; Holy Fire

keys.text: Cast Holy Fire
Cast Smite

macros.needs: Holy Fire learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Punição; Fogo Sagrado
/cast [mod:shift] Punição; Fogo Sagrado

macros.title: Greater Heal, Rank 1 with Shift
macros.desc: Greater Heal your mouseover, target or yourself. Hold Shift for Rank 1 when the damage is small.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Greater Heal
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Greater Heal(Rank 1); [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Greater Heal

keys.text: Top-rank Greater Heal on your mouseover, target or you
Rank 1 Greater Heal on the same aim

macros.needs: Greater Heal learned (level 40)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Cura Maior
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Cura Maior(Grau 1); [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Cura Maior

macros.title: Mouseover Renew, Rank 5 with Shift
macros.desc: Renew your mouseover, target or yourself. Hold Shift for Rank 5 to save Mana. Blizzard confirms Renew from different Priests can stay active on the same target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Renew
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Renew(Rank 5); [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Renew

keys.text: Top-rank Renew on your mouseover, target or you
Rank 5 Renew on the same aim

macros.needs: Renew learned. Rank 5 comes at level 32.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Renovar
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Renovar(Grau 5); [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Renovar

macros.title: Prayer of Healing on a chosen group
macros.desc: Cast Prayer of Healing on the friend under your cursor to heal their party, including pets, so you pick which party gets it.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Prayer of Healing
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Prayer of Healing
macros.needs: Prayer of Healing learned (level 30). Blizzard confirms it heals the target's party, including pets; the client lists a 40 yard radius. Classic healed your own party.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Prece de Cura
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Prece de Cura

macros.title: Mouseover Prayer of Mending
macros.desc: Put Prayer of Mending on your mouseover, target or yourself. Damage or non-periodic healing triggers its heal and a jump to a nearby party or raid member.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Prayer of Mending
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Prayer of Mending
macros.needs: Prayer of Mending talent (Holy); rank 1 is level 40 in the client, with a 10 sec cooldown. Blizzard describes five heals and one active application per target; the tooltip says five jumps and one target per caster. We haven't tested those limits in game.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Prece da Recomposição
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Prece da Recomposição

macros.title: Abolish Disease, Cure Disease with Shift
macros.desc: Abolish Disease on your mouseover, target or yourself. Hold Shift for a one-off Cure Disease.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Abolish Disease
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Cure Disease; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Abolish Disease

keys.text: Abolish Disease on your mouseover, target or you
Cure Disease on the same aim

macros.needs: Abolish Disease learned (level 32). Before that, use a Cure Disease macro on its own.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Abolir Doença
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][mod:shift,help,nodead][mod:shift,@player] Curar Doença; [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Abolir Doença

macros.title: Holy Fire pull, then wand
macros.desc: Open with Holy Fire on the first press, then press again to start wanding.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Holy Fire
/castsequence reset=target/combat Holy Fire, !Shoot
macros.needs: Holy Fire learned and a wand equipped
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Fogo Sagrado
/castsequence reset=target/combat Fogo Sagrado, !Atirar

macros.title: Alternate two heals for Litany of Light
macros.desc: Alternate Flash Heal and Greater Heal on one button so each cast differs from the last, which is what Litany of Light rewards.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Flash Heal
/castsequence [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] reset=4 Flash Heal, Greater Heal
macros.needs: Litany of Light talent (Holy) and Greater Heal learned (level 40). The sequence starts over after 4 seconds without a press.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Cura Célere
/castsequence [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] reset=4 Cura Célere, Cura Maior

macros.title: Smite your tank's target
macros.desc: Smite your hostile target, or the enemy your friendly target is attacking. Leave your tank selected while dealing damage between heals; it won't interrupt a channel.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Smite
/stopmacro [channeling]
/cast [harm,nodead][@targettarget,harm,nodead] Smite
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Punição
/stopmacro [channeling]
/cast [harm,nodead][@targettarget,harm,nodead] Punição

macros.title: Mouseover Shadow Word: Pain
macros.desc: Apply your damage-over-time spell to a mouseover without switching target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Shadow Word: Pain
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Shadow Word: Pain
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Palavra Sombria: Dor
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Palavra Sombria: Dor

macros.title: Mouseover Shadow Word: Death
macros.desc: Use Forever’s finisher on a mouseover or your target. If it hits and fails to kill, you take 30% of your max health as damage.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Shadow Word: Death
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Shadow Word: Death
macros.needs: Shadow Word: Death learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Palavra Sombria: Morte
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][] Palavra Sombria: Morte

macros.title: Shadowform on, Shift to drop it
macros.desc: Enter Shadowform when you're not in it. Hold Shift to drop it.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Shadowform
/cancelaura [mod:shift] Shadowform
/cast [nomod,noform:1] Shadowform

keys.text: Enter Shadowform if you aren't in it
Drop Shadowform

macros.needs: Shadowform talent (Shadow, level 40). Classic macros count Shadowform as form 1. We haven't checked that in Forever's client.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Forma de Sombra
/cancelaura [mod:shift] Forma de Sombra
/cast [nomod,noform:1] Forma de Sombra

macros.title: Drop Shadowform and Flash Heal
macros.desc: Drop Shadowform and Flash Heal your mouseover, target or yourself in one press. Recast Shadowform afterwards.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Flash Heal
/cancelaura Shadowform
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Flash Heal
macros.needs: Shadowform talent and Flash Heal learned. Forever blocks healing spells while you're in Shadowform.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Cura Célere
/cancelaura Forma de Sombra
/cast [@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Cura Célere

macros.title: Mind Flay that won't restart
macros.desc: Spam Mind Flay without restarting the channel every time you press it.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Mind Flay
/cast [nochanneling:Mind Flay] Mind Flay
macros.needs: Mind Flay talent (Shadow, level 20)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Açoite Mental
/cast [nochanneling:Mind Flay] Açoite Mental

macros.title: Mind Blast, Shift for Mind Flay
macros.desc: Press for Mind Blast. Hold Shift for Mind Flay, which won't restart while you're already channeling it.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Mind Flay; Mind Blast
/cast [mod:shift,nochanneling:Mind Flay] Mind Flay; [nomod] Mind Blast

keys.text: Cast Mind Blast
Cast Mind Flay unless you're already channeling it

macros.needs: Mind Flay talent (Shadow, level 20)
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Açoite Mental; Impacto Mental
/cast [mod:shift,nochanneling:Mind Flay] Açoite Mental; [nomod] Impacto Mental

macros.title: Mouseover Devouring Plague
macros.desc: Put Devouring Plague on your mouseover or target. The damage it does heals you.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Devouring Plague
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Devouring Plague
macros.needs: Devouring Plague learned (level 20). Every Priest gets it in Forever, with a 24 sec cooldown since 15 October. In Classic it was an Undead racial spell with a 3 min cooldown.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Peste Devoradora
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Peste Devoradora

macros.title: Mouseover Vampiric Embrace
macros.desc: Afflict your mouseover or target so your Shadow damage heals your party.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Vampiric Embrace
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Vampiric Embrace
macros.needs: Vampiric Embrace talent (Shadow), a 16-point talent you can take at 25. It lasts 30 sec with a 30 sec cooldown since 15 October, so you can keep it up. Classic's lasted 1 min with a 10 sec cooldown.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Abraço Vampírico
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Abraço Vampírico

macros.title: Mouseover Starshards
macros.desc: Rain Starshards on your mouseover or target.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Starshards
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Starshards
macros.needs: Night Elf Priest. Starshards is a Night Elf racial spell. It has a 30 sec cooldown in Forever, and Classic's had none.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Fragmentos Estelares
/cast [@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Fragmentos Estelares

macros.title: Shadow Word: Pain, then wand
macros.desc: The first press applies Shadow Word: Pain. Each press after that starts or keeps up the wand.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Shadow Word: Pain
/castsequence reset=target/combat Shadow Word: Pain, !Shoot
macros.needs: A wand equipped in the ranged slot
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Palavra Sombria: Dor
/castsequence reset=target/combat Palavra Sombria: Dor, !Atirar

macros.title: Psychic Scream, Shift for Fade
macros.desc: Cancel your current cast, then Psychic Scream the enemies around you. Hold Shift for Fade instead. Blizzard's 30 September guide says Fade's threat reduction is doubled.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Fade; Psychic Scream
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift] Fade; Psychic Scream

keys.text: Stop your cast, Psychic Scream
Stop your cast, Fade

macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Desvanecer; Grito Psíquico
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift] Desvanecer; Grito Psíquico

macros.title: Mind Control, Shift for Shackle Undead
macros.desc: Mind Control the enemy under your cursor, or your target. Hold Shift to Shackle Undead instead.
macros.code:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Shackle Undead; Mind Control
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift,harm,nodead] Shackle Undead; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Mind Control

keys.text: Mind Control your mouseover, then your target
Shackle Undead your mouseover, then your target

macros.needs: Mind Control learned (level 30). Rank 3 works on humanoids up to level 62. Shackle Undead learned for Shift.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip [mod:shift] Agrilhoar Morto-vivo; Controle Mental
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift,harm,nodead] Agrilhoar Morto-vivo; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Controle Mental

macros.title: Dispel Magic on four aims
macros.desc: One Dispel Magic button: target by default, mouseover with Shift, you with Ctrl, your target's target with Alt.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Dispel Magic
/cast [mod:ctrl,@player][mod:shift,@mouseover,exists,nodead][mod:alt,@targettarget,help,nodead][] Dispel Magic

keys.text: Dispel your target
Dispel your mouseover
Dispel yourself
Dispel your target's target if it's a friend

macros.needs: Dispel Magic learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Dissipar Magia
/cast [mod:ctrl,@player][mod:shift,@mouseover,exists,nodead][mod:alt,@targettarget,help,nodead][] Dissipar Magia

macros.title: Trinket and shield
macros.desc: Cancel your cast, use your top trinket and shield yourself. Hold Shift to shield your mouseover ally with no trinket.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Power Word: Shield
/stopcasting
/use [nomod] 13
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][@player] Power Word: Shield

keys.text: Stop your cast, use trinket slot 13, shield yourself
Stop your cast, shield your mouseover ally

macros.needs: An on-use trinket in the top trinket slot. Weakened Soul stops a second shield on the same target.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Palavra de Poder: Escudo
/stopcasting
/use [nomod] 13
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,help,nodead][@player] Palavra de Poder: Escudo

macros.title: Shield party 1 or 2, or your enemy's target
macros.desc: Shield your friendly mouseover or target. With an enemy targeted, it shields the friend that enemy has targeted, or you. Shift shields party member 1 and Ctrl party member 2.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Power Word: Shield
/cast [mod:shift,@party1][mod:ctrl,@party2][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@targettarget,help,nodead][@player] Power Word: Shield

keys.text: Shield your mouseover, your target, your enemy's target, then you
Shield party member 1
Shield party member 2

macros.needs: Power Word: Shield learned. Weakened Soul stops a second shield on the same target for 15 sec.
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Palavra de Poder: Escudo
/cast [mod:shift,@party1][mod:ctrl,@party2][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@targettarget,help,nodead][@player] Palavra de Poder: Escudo

macros.title: Stop and Flash Heal
macros.desc: Cancel your cast and Flash Heal your mouseover, target or yourself. Hold Shift to heal yourself.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Flash Heal
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift,@player][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Flash Heal

keys.text: Stop your cast, heal your mouseover, target or you
Stop your cast, heal yourself

macros.needs: Flash Heal learned
macros.codePt:
#showtooltip Cura Célere
/stopcasting
/cast [mod:shift,@player][@mouseover,help,nodead][help,nodead][@player] Cura Célere

macros.title: Shadow Word: Pain, Shift for Devouring Plague
macros.desc: Shadow Word: Pain on your mouseover or target. Hold Shift for Devouring Plague on the same aim.
macros.code:
#showtooltip Shadow Word: Pain
/cast [mod:shift,@mouseover,harm,nodead][mod:shift,harm,nodead] Devouring Plague; [@mouseover,harm,nodead][harm,nodead] Shadow Word: Pain

keys.text: Shadow Word: Pain on your mouseover, then your target
Devouring Plague on your mouseover, then your target

macros.needs: Devouring Plague learned (level 20). Every Priest gets it in Forever, with a 24 sec cooldown.
macros.codePt:
